tools.name: check_device_support
tools.description: Check whether a GPS tracking device is supported by GpsGate. Matches on device model, manufacturer, or GpsGate plugin name, and returns a link to each matching device's page.

device.description: Device model or manufacturer to look up, for example "FMB920" or "Queclink".

tools.name: list_supported_manufacturers
tools.description: List the GPS device manufacturers GpsGate supports, with the number of device models available for each.
